Use in this project
  Only for cross-checking the golden model (test/xcheck_pqcrystals.cpp).
  The golden model itself does not include or link this code.
  Build: gcc -std=c99 -DKYBER_K=3 (KYBER_K only selects the symbol namespace;
  ntt/reduce are identical for all K).
